name: Exp_KalmanFilterCandle
summary: This EA trades based on the KalmanFilterCandle custom indicator, opening buy positions when the indicator signals an uptrend (color value transitions to 2) and sell positions when it signals a downtrend (color value transitions to 0). It uses a Kalman filter to smooth price action into candlestick-like signals and executes trades with configurable stop-loss and take-profit levels on each new bar.
summary_zh: 该EA基于KalmanFilterCandle自定义指标进行交易，当指标信号颜色值转为2时开多仓，转为0时开空仓。它使用卡尔曼滤波器将价格行为平滑为类K线信号，并在每个新K线出现时执行交易，配有可配置的止损和止盈水平。
strategy_analysis: 该EA的核心策略基于卡尔曼滤波器（Kalman Filter）对价格进行平滑处理，生成类K线的趋势方向信号。入场条件为：当指标buffer第4线的颜色值从非2变为2时，触发买入开仓信号；当颜色值从非0变为0时，触发卖出开仓信号。出场条件分为两种：止损和止盈通过固定点数（StopLoss_=1000, TakeProfit_=2000）实现，同时趋势反转时也会平仓（BuyPosClose/SellPosClose）。仓位管理采用两种模式：固定手数或基于资金的百分比（由MM和MMMode参数控制），通过TradeAlgorithms.mqh库函数实现。资金管理方面，MM参数默认0.1，配合LOT或RISK模式决定下单量。策略在H4周期默认运行，使用SignalBar=1（前一根已闭合K线）来确认信号，避免未闭合K线的反复信号问题。EA还提供了四个布尔开关分别控制买入开仓、卖出开仓、买入平仓和卖出平仓，实现了灵活的信号执行控制。
strategy_analysis_en: The core strategy relies on a Kalman Filter to smooth price data and generate candlestick-like trend direction signals. Entry conditions: when the indicator's buffer 4 color value transitions from non-2 to 2, a buy signal is triggered; when it transitions from non-0 to 0, a sell signal is triggered. Exit conditions are twofold: fixed stop-loss (1000 points) and take-profit (2000 points) levels, plus trend-reversal-based closing when the signal flips direction. Position sizing supports two modes: fixed lot size or risk-based percentage of account margin (controlled by MM and MMMode parameters), implemented via the TradeAlgorithms.mqh library. Money management uses MM default of 0.1, paired with LOT or RISK mode to determine order volume. The strategy operates on H4 timeframe by default and uses SignalBar=1 (the previous closed bar) for signal confirmation, avoiding false signals from unclosed bars. The EA provides four boolean switches to independently control buy open, sell open, buy close, and sell close actions, enabling flexible signal execution control.

parameters.name: MM
parameters.description: 资金管理参数，控制下单手数或风险比例

parameters.name: MMMode
parameters.description: 手数计算模式：固定手数(LOT)或基于资金(RISK)
parameters.description_en: Position sizing mode (free margin/balance/net free margin/net balance/fixed lot)

parameters.name: BuyPosClose
parameters.description: 是否允许买入平仓（多仓平仓）

parameters.name: SellPosClose
parameters.description: 是否允许卖出平仓（空仓平仓）

parameters.name: SignalBar
parameters.description: 用于获取交易信号的K线索引（1=前一根已闭合K线）

parameters.name: K
parameters.description: 卡尔曼滤波器的平滑系数，值越大响应越快
parameters.description_en: Kalman filter smoothing coefficient; higher = faster response

pros: 使用卡尔曼滤波器进行价格平滑，相比简单移动平均能有效减少滞后性同时过滤噪声
采用SignalBar=1确认已闭合K线信号，避免未闭合K线产生的虚假信号
提供四个独立的买卖开关，可灵活控制只开仓不平仓或只平仓不开仓
使用IsNewBar机制确保每个K线只计算一次信号，避免tick级别的重复计算
止损止盈配置完善，默认2:1的盈亏比有利于长期正期望
pros_en: Uses Kalman Filter for price smoothing, which reduces lag compared to simple moving averages while effectively filtering noise
Employs SignalBar=1 to confirm signals from closed bars, avoiding false signals from unclosed bars
Provides four independent buy/sell switches for flexible control over opening and closing positions separately
Uses IsNewBar mechanism to ensure signal calculation happens only once per bar, avoiding tick-level redundant computation
Complete stop-loss and take-profit configuration with a default 2:1 reward-to-risk ratio favorable for long-term positive expectancy
cons: 依赖外部自定义指标KalmanFilterCandle和TradeAlgorithms.mqh库，缺少这些文件EA无法运行
没有持仓检查机制，可能在已有同方向仓位时重复开仓
缺少点差过滤，在高点差环境下止损止盈可能被轻易触发
止损1000点和止盈2000点数值偏大，不适用于所有品种和周期
没有回撤控制或最大持仓限制，极端行情下风险敞口不可控
cons_en: Depends on external custom indicator KalmanFilterCandle and TradeAlgorithms.mqh library; EA cannot run without these files
No position check mechanism; may open duplicate positions in the same direction when already holding a position
No spread filter; stop-loss and take-profit can be easily triggered in high-spread environments
Stop-loss of 1000 points and take-profit of 2000 points are large values that may not suit all instruments and timeframes
No drawdown control or maximum position limit; risk exposure is uncontrolled during extreme market conditions
improvements: 添加持仓检查逻辑，避免同方向重复开仓导致仓位过重
增加点差过滤和时间过滤（如避开新闻时段），提高入场质量
将止损止盈改为基于ATR的动态计算，适应不同品种的波动特性
improvements_en: Add position check logic to avoid duplicate openings in the same direction, preventing over-concentration of positions
Add spread filter and time filter (e.g., avoiding news periods) to improve entry quality
Change stop-loss and take-profit to ATR-based dynamic calculation to adapt to volatility characteristics of different instruments

risk_points: 缺少持仓检查，可能同方向重复开仓导致过度杠杆
固定点数止损止盈不适应所有品种波动率，小波动品种可能止损过宽而大波动品种止损过窄
依赖外部指标文件，缺失时EA静默失败仅打印日志
risk_points_en: No position check; may open duplicate same-direction positions leading to excessive leverage
Fixed-point stop-loss and take-profit don't adapt to all instruments' volatility; may be too wide for low-volatility or too narrow for high-volatility instruments
Depends on external indicator file; EA silently fails with only a log print when the file is missing
